Product details

Ride smarter with the FLYPKIN electric bike, powered by a 500W motor reaching speeds up to 20 MPH. Enjoy up to 30 miles of range on a single charge, perfect for quick city trips.

Designed for comfort and safety, it features dual suspension, 14" inflatable tires, and reliable electronic + disc brakes for a smooth, controlled ride. Stay connected with the smart app and LCD display to track speed, battery, and modes in real time.

Lightweight and foldable, it’s easy to carry, store, and take anywhere—built for life on the go.

🚀 Powerful Motor & Smooth Riding Experience

Equipped with a high-performance 500W brushless motor, this FLYPKIN electric bike delivers a top speed of up to 20 MPH, providing strong and stable power for Going to school or the office or short-distance travel. Supports riders up to 264 lbs, making it suitable for teens and adults alike.

🔋 Long Range Battery & Fast Charging

Built with a reliable high-capacity battery, this e-bike offers up to 30 miles of riding range on a single charge. With a quick 5–6 hour charging time, you can spend more time riding and less time waiting.

📱 Smart App Control & LED Display

Stay in control with the integrated smart app and clear LCD display. Monitor speed, battery level, and riding mode in real time. The app also supports features like lock/unlock, cruise control, and riding mode adjustment for a smarter driving.

🧳 Foldable & Portable Design

Lightweight design at approximately with a one-step folding system allows you to fold the scooter in seconds. Easy to carry, store in your car trunk, office, or take on public transport—perfect for urban lifestyles.

🚲Enhanced Comfort and Safety

Equipped with front dual suspension and 14-inch inflatable tires, our electric bike guarantees a smooth ride over various terrains, coupled with electronic brakes and disc brakes for reliable stopping power
